info.title: An Cư — selection-bound contract drafts
info.description: Implemented private contract authoring, exact-party PDF and hand-drawn electronic signatures, renewal requests and expiry handover. Tenant requests renewal; Owner accepts/rejects before drafting a new agreement. Signed future renewals wait until the next start date; no automatic expiry release or provider-certified digital signature. V42 adds persistent in-app 20/10-day reminders and request state/version. Old saved snapshots remain immutable; missing legacy originals are not fabricated. See tenant-renewal-requests-v1 ADR for detailed transitions and safeguards.

id.description: Frozen identifier string: legacy UUID or new numeric ID; snapshot unchanged.

Party.description: Private exact-contract-party fields derived from saved identity, falling back to display profile when absent. Never includes identity images. Old snapshots can lack new fields. Email possession and legal identity remain separate.

cancellationState.description: PENDING pauses draft create/edit/sign; CANCELLED initial contract is read-only history, distinct from ENDED.

Handover.description: Exact-party handover with actual end meter readings, immutable settlement values, owner/customer confirmation timestamps and optimistic version.

handoverAvailable.description: Server eligibility on/after end date with no pending request, open successor or pending handover.

renewalRequestAvailable.description: Server eligibility starting ten days before the end date. Requires ACTIVE, no request, open successor or pending handover. Existing post-expiry resolution remains supported.

renewalRequestOpensOn.description: Contract end date minus ten days, evaluated in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Earlier POST renewal-request returns 409 RENEWAL_REQUEST_TOO_EARLY.
